title: Override autocrlf=false at every memory git operation
context: Git-for-Windows installer default (autocrlf=true) re-encodes graph JSON to CRLF during add/commit/checkout, corrupting byte-exact content that merge drivers and hashes depend on. Touches invariant(s): con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file).
decision: Pin core.autocrlf=false via -c flag on every memory-tree git call (add, commit, reset, merge, team materialization) rather than relying on system gitconfig.
consequences: Memory operations become immune to system gitconfig autocrlf defaults
Protects byte-exact graph content integrity across all platforms
Adds explicit -c flags to all memory git invocations (verbosity vs. safety tradeoff)
alternatives_rejected: Change system gitconfig globally — requires admin privileges, fragile across environments
Use .gitattributes to control per-file encoding — insufficient for binary/byte-exact content
Patch merge driver and hash logic to tolerate CRLF — fixes symptom, not root cause
Accept CRLF encoding — breaks content hashing and merge semantics
